title: Bearing the Humans
content: Brown bears across Europe are responding to the human footprint, with space use and movement behaviour strongly influenced by limited habitat connectivity. While natural food availability and habitat suitability remain important for bears, growing human pressure is increasingly constraining their ecological role. The picture was drawn by Andrea Gazzola.
author:
Andrea Corradini, 
Steffen Mumme, 
Francesca Cagnacci
